$comment: Single source of truth for Sim-Roaster technical dependencies. Read by lib/continuity/*, scripts/dr/env-inventory.mjs and docs/business-continuity.md. Lists env var NAMES only, never values.

tiers.1: Critical: core rostering cannot be read or changed without it
tiers.2: Important: a significant function is lost but a workaround exists
tiers.3: Supporting: convenience or secondary channel; manual workaround is acceptable
tiers.4: Non-essential: test, telemetry or cosmetic only

dependencies.name: Vercel (hosting, serverless functions, routing, deployments)
dependencies.usedFor: Serves the Next.js app and every /api route; holds environment configuration; runs the scheduled backup cron.

dependencies.name: Vercel Blob (private store)
dependencies.usedFor: System of record for operational roster data (sim-roster/state.json), snapshot backups (sim-roster/backups/), backup manifests and DR evidence (sim-roster/dr/), training attachments, monitor archives.
dependencies.failureImpact: Roster cannot be loaded or saved; backups and attachments unavailable.

dependencies.name: Neon PostgreSQL
dependencies.usedFor: Better Auth users/sessions/accounts, the append-only audit trail (audit.event), the ops relational schema (migration target).
dependencies.failureImpact: Nobody can sign in. Roster writes, restores and backup deletions are refused because the audit trail is fail-closed.

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED
envVars.note: Used by migration and DR scripts.

dependencies.name: Better Auth (email + password, in-app)
dependencies.usedFor: Sign-in, sessions, role resolution for every authorised API call.
dependencies.failureImpact: All authenticated pages and APIs return 401 / redirect to /login.

dependencies.name: Microsoft Entra ID (optional SSO)
dependencies.failureImpact: Microsoft sign-in fails; email + password still works.

dependencies.name: Resend (transactional email)
dependencies.failureImpact: Emails not delivered. Without a key the route runs in simulated mode. Notify staff by another channel.

dependencies.name: GitHub (djvenom-collab/Sim-Roaster)
dependencies.usedFor: Source of truth for code, migrations, runbooks; triggers Vercel deployments.
dependencies.failureImpact: No new deployments; the running deployment is unaffected.

dependencies.name: npm registry and Google Fonts (build time only)
dependencies.usedFor: Dependency install and next/font download during build.
dependencies.failureImpact: New builds fail; running deployments and Instant Rollback are unaffected.

dependencies.name: Autonoma (E2E test data)
dependencies.failureImpact: Automated E2E runs fail; no production impact.

dependencies.name: AI services
dependencies.usedFor: Not used. No AI SDK or model provider is a dependency (verified in package.json).

components.name: Monitor page (/monitor). Shows synthetic metrics, not real telemetry.
